name: Test the editor's UI behaviour headlessly
body: Nothing tests the world editor's UI behaviour: the services refactor (lantern #49) was checked by reading, by mounting the tree and by hand on Xvfb. Add headless tests that mount `App.chaos` through the bridge with stubbed `editor*` host functions (as penumbra-bridge's `nox/tools/measure-editor.sh` does) and drive the services directly: selection with modifiers, the context menu's commands, Escape closing overlays in order, the save-first confirm, palette filtering. Raised in the review of lantern #49.
